executive_summary: Today's OFAC sanctions list update includes 13 additions and 1 update, primarily targeting individuals and entities in Iran and the United Arab Emirates. The additions are mainly related to the IFSR and SDGT programs, indicating a focus on counter-terrorism and sanctions evasion. The update involves the addition of the SDGT program to an existing entity, Primeiro Comando Da Capital.

The update to Primeiro Comando Da Capital may indicate a broader focus on counter-terrorism and organized crime, potentially affecting global financial transactions.
